[11:03PM] #Ijanikin #TrafficUpdate 

Good vehicular movement from Abule-Ado to Iyana Iba, encompassing Ojo Barracks, Agric, Volkswagen, Afolabi Ege Fruits market.
Unencumbered traffic flow from Alaba Rago to Custom Checkpoint Ijanikin, covering Okokomaiko, Iyana Isashi, and Iyana Era.
Smooth and swift movement from Iyana Iba intersection to Obadore Bridge, passing through Techno U-turn, First Gate, Ipaye, and Iyana School.

Good traffic flow on the return journey from Obadore Bridge back to Iyana Iba.

#FollowLASTMA
